name: prompt-convert-trigger-plugin
description: Automatically detects complex or multi-step tasks and converts them into structured COSTAR or CRISPE prompts. Triggers proactively when user requests involve 3+ steps, multiple conditions, vague requirements, multi-file scope, or research plus implementation work. Also applies to Chinese-language requests with the same signals: multi-goal phrasing, uncertainty markers ('我不确定', '可能是'), or vague action verbs ('改进', '优化', '搞定').
